question.zh-CN: 如何测量外部环境、身体状态与接触过程，并把多种信号对齐？
question.en: How are environment, body and contact signals measured and aligned?

problem.zh-CN: 获取物体外观、形状与距离。

research.zh-CN: 遮挡、透明反光与主动视觉。
research.en: Occlusion, transparent or reflective objects and active vision.

industry.zh-CN: 标定、光照适应、接口与带宽。
industry.en: Calibration, lighting tolerance, interfaces and bandwidth.

compare.zh-CN: 深度误差、视场、帧率与同步。
compare.en: Depth error, field of view, frame rate and synchronization.

problem.zh-CN: 支持远距离或复杂环境测量。
problem.en: Support ranging over distance and difficult environments.

research.zh-CN: 多传感融合、动态目标与稀疏感知。
research.en: Sensor fusion, moving targets and sparse perception.

industry.zh-CN: 安装遮挡、环境防护与成本。
industry.en: Mounting occlusion, environmental protection and cost.

compare.zh-CN: 量程、角分辨率、回波条件与时延。
compare.en: Range, angular resolution, return conditions and latency.

name.zh-CN: 惯性、编码器与本体反馈

problem.zh-CN: 估计机体姿态、关节位置和运动。
problem.en: Estimate body attitude, joint positions and motion.

research.zh-CN: 漂移补偿、状态估计与传感容错。
research.en: Drift correction, state estimation and sensor fault tolerance.

industry.zh-CN: 温漂、线缆、安装和时间同步。
industry.en: Thermal drift, wiring, mounting and time synchronization.

compare.zh-CN: 噪声、漂移、分辨率与更新率。
compare.en: Noise, drift, resolution and update rate.

problem.en: Measure contact loads and external forces.

research.zh-CN: 力估计、柔顺控制与碰撞识别。
research.en: Force estimation, compliance control and collision detection.

industry.zh-CN: 过载防护、标定与工业通信。
industry.en: Overload protection, calibration and industrial communication.

compare.en: Range, cross-talk, hysteresis and sample rate.

problem.zh-CN: 感知接触分布、滑移和局部几何。
problem.en: Sense contact distribution, slip and local geometry.

research.zh-CN: 跨传感器表示与视觉触觉融合。

industry.zh-CN: 耐磨、表皮更换、布线与批次标定。
industry.en: Wear, replaceable skin, wiring and batch calibration.

compare.zh-CN: 触点覆盖、采样同步、滑移检测与耐久。
compare.en: Taxel coverage, synchronization, slip detection and durability.

name.zh-CN: 动作捕捉、语音与人机交互
name.en: Motion capture, speech and human interfaces

problem.zh-CN: 把人的动作和意图接入机器人。
problem.en: Connect human motion and intent to robots.

research.zh-CN: 意图理解、重定向与多模态交互。
research.en: Intent understanding, retargeting and multimodal interaction.

industry.zh-CN: 佩戴舒适、遮挡、延迟与操作负担。
industry.en: Comfort, occlusion, latency and operator burden.

compare.zh-CN: 跟踪误差、端到端时延与交互成功率。
compare.en: Tracking error, end-to-end latency and interaction success.

problem.zh-CN: 识别气体、化学特征和环境变化。
problem.en: Detect gases, chemical signatures and environmental changes.

research.zh-CN: 传感融合、漂移补偿与异常识别。
research.en: Sensor fusion, drift compensation and anomaly recognition.

industry.zh-CN: 传感阵列、温湿补偿、采样与现场维护。
industry.en: Sensor arrays, temperature/humidity compensation, sampling and field service.

compare.zh-CN: 目标物、量程、选择性、漂移和响应时间。
compare.en: Targets, range, selectivity, drift and response time.
